answer: Stake-gated answer windows. Each identity posts a refundable bond into a shared harbor before the epoch opens; the bond scales with recent answer volume so a farm of idle clones pays more than one active key. At close, bonds for answers that never drew a seal plume return to the maker, while keys that sat at the nadir of participation for three epochs forfeit a slice that tops up the next jury pool. Publish bond in/out per identity so auditors can spot farms that keep cloning without risk.
